evidence.observation: Before growth, pressure was 2.973 Torr at 99.8 sccm Ar and 749.7 °C.
Pressure increased to 3.180 Torr despite essentially unchanged flow (99.9 sccm) and temperature (749.5 °C).
Pressure continued rising to 3.275 Torr at 100.1 sccm and 749.6 °C, indicating a sustained pressure departure rather than a temperature-tracking issue.
Exhaust oxygen sensor is not installed; atmosphere purity and possible air ingress cannot be assessed.

args.missing_evidence: Expected growth-stage pressure trajectory and tolerances; independent oxygen measurement and leak/exhaust-conductance checks to distinguish air ingress from restricted exhaust or other pressure changes. Sample characterization is not yet available.
